semiconductor_relevance: High — Nearfield Instruments provides advanced metrology solutions crucial for IC device manufacturing, especially for sub-10 nm technologies.
summary: Nearfield Instruments B.V. specializes in advanced metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-throughput atomic force microscopy (AFM) systems. Their technology provides atom-scale resolution 3D metrology, significantly enhancing the in-fab metrology toolset for sub-10 nm device generations.
